The '''Valarian Strategic Command Bunker''' was a fortress located on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the structure was used by [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian's]] [[Valarian Syndicate|gang]] to plan actions against [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] and other enemies. It was located between the [[Western Dune Sea/Legends|Western Dune Sea]] and the [[Lowland Basin/Legends|Lowland Basin]], northeast of the [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Wayfar/Legends|Wayfar]] and [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]]. Among the base's occupants were a number of Valarian's armored command enforcers.<ref name="SWG:JPJTH" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] sent a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to the bunker to eliminate Valarian's command staff. Among those [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the raid were [[weaponsmith]] [[Arkahn Greystar]], [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[Iris Tanada Sinclair]], [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Careem]], tactician [[Fnast Drexler]], and [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Emanon]]. The spacer succeeded and was rewarded by Jabba.<ref name="SWG:JPJTH" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Valarian Strategic Command Bunker was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:JPJTH" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Valarian Strategic Command Bunker was added to the game as part of the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Jabba's Theme Park|Jabba's Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:JPJTH" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
